topic: Remotion: making videos with React code
angle: A video is a function of the frame number, so anyone who can write a React component can write a video. Show the idea, the one hook that matters, and the one command that renders it.

claims.text: Remotion is a framework for making videos programmatically with React.
Remotion gives you a frame number and a blank canvas, and you render anything you want on it using React.
A video is a function of images over time; if the content changes every frame you get an animation.
A video has width, height, durationInFrames and fps; the first frame is 0 and the last is durationInFrames minus one.
The useCurrentFrame() hook returns the current frame of the video; frames are 0-indexed.
You render a video from the command line with 'npx remotion render' (or the Render button in Remotion Studio).
The remotion-dev/remotion repository had about 73,500 GitHub stars when captured on 2026-11-16.
